caption: The drawing depicts a figure of a person standing on a small, flat, oval-shaped platform colored green and yellow. The person is dressed in a yellow outfit adorned with small round details and red trim at the cuffs, neckline, waist, and hem. The individual’s face is reddish-brown, and their black hair is tied back and partially covered by a headband decorated with four upright feathers in green, yellow, and red. The figure’s right arm is extended straight forward, with the index finger pointing; the left arm is bent, grasping a large, curved, dark brown bow. A quiver or sheath hangs diagonally from the waist, holding a dark object. The person's shoes are yellow and outlined with red. The figure is also supported by a vertical brown rod that extends from the platform to the torso, with a horizontal brace at the waist. The background is a plain, light beige color.
title: Indian Weather Vane
